name: Woolworth Poker
description: Woolworth Poker is a home poker variant where 5s and 10s are wild cards (named after Woolworth's 'five and dime' stores). Any standard poker variant can use Woolworth rules. Wild 5s and 10s can represent any card. Five-of-a-kind becomes possible and ranks above straight flush.

content.text: Woolworth Poker is a home poker variant where 5s and 10s are wild cards (named after Woolworth's 'five and dime' stores). Any standard poker variant can use Woolworth rules. Wild 5s and 10s can represent any card. Five-of-a-kind becomes possible and ranks above straight flush.

Woolworth Poker is named after the American retailer F.W. Woolworth and his famous five-and-dime stores, where items cost five or ten cents. The game makes 5s and 10s wild as a playful reference to those prices and became a common home poker rule in 20th-century American play.

items.text: Extra Card for a Two: Some play that a player who is dealt a two receives an extra card (similar to Baseball's four).
Pay for Face-Up 5s and 10s: Arthur Buderick version: players must pay a fixed amount (e.g. $1) to the pot for each 10 or 5 received face up; no extra cards dealt.
